summary: Full backend + frontend acceptance for AVISION ONE Super Admin CMS Suite. Backend: 47/47 pytest cases pass — 27 in existing test_cms_suite.py + 14 golden-path checks + 20 in new test_cms_extended.py (covers CRUD for the 12 entities missed by the existing parametrize, website/app visibility filter, inactive-hidden guard, foundation regression, validation). Frontend: admin login works, sidebar contains every section (Identity, Academic, Catalog, Learning Content, Content Mgmt, Organisation, Reports) with NO 'soon' pills, /admin/testimonials + /admin/banners + /admin/faqs + /admin/reports all load real seed data, and end-to-end 'New Testimonial' create-flow via the UI succeeded (row visible in list immediately). All 11 reports return 200 with proper shape. Public /api/cms/testimonials?client=website vs ?client=app visibility split works. /api/cms/question_bank correctly returns 404 (not public). Auth guards (401 no-token, 403 non-admin) work.

minor.issue: 'display_order' is not in the allowed fields list for these two entities, so PATCH {display_order:N} returns 400 'Nothing to update'. All 18 other entities include it. Consider adding for consistency + stable ordering.

react_native_issues.issue: No testID attributes on the New/Create/Save/Delete/Edit buttons or form fields. Automation had to fall back to text-based get_by_text('New')/get_by_text('Create') selectors — brittle. Recommend testID='cms-new-btn', 'cms-create-btn', 'cms-save-btn', 'cms-delete-btn', and per-field testID={`cms-field-${field.name}`}. Reference: /app/frontend/src/admin/EntityScreen.tsx:119, 201.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add 'display_order' to fields list of question_bank and centres_v2 in ENTITY_REGISTRY (avision_cms.py) for consistency with the other 18 entities.
(Testability) Add testID attributes to Btn (label='New'/'Create'/'Save changes'/etc.) and to each form field inside EntityScreen.tsx so future automation doesn't rely on text.
No blocking issues — feature is production-shape green.
critical_code_review_comments: avision_cms.py is 895 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold. Consider splitting REPORTS section into avision_reports.py (each `if slug == ...` block into a dispatch dict) once more reports are added.
In _list_entity the .to_list(limit) argument is redundant with .limit(limit); harmless but non-idiomatic.
_slugify does not guarantee ASCII/URL-safety for non-Latin titles — fine for current scope but flag if the CMS accepts Bengali/Hindi titles later.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — all test data auto-cleaned in fixtures (delete after create). One residual UI-created testimonial ('UI-Test-1785859290') left from the manual smoke and can be removed by admin if desired.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend has full CMS coverage now: test_cms_suite.py (27) + test_cms_extended.py (20) + test_golden_path.py (14). Run all with: cd /app/backend && TEST_BASE=<preview-url> python -m pytest tests/test_cms_suite.py tests/test_cms_extended.py tests/test_golden_path.py -v. Login button on /admin/login is labeled 'Sign in to Admin' (not 'Login'). Search box shares the input pool so filter it out before targeting modal fields.
rca_of_issue: n/a — no bugs to root-cause. Two intermediate test failures during extended-suite drafting were caused by my own choice of a non-universal PATCH field (display_order); corrected by patching {active:false} instead. Root cause of that inconsistency logged as a minor backend action item.
